outcome: intra-operative injury to the urinary bladder
cohort: Women undergoing hysterectomy after 22 weeks of gestational age and within 6 weeks of delivery over a period of 1 year at Nalanda Medical College & Hospital, Patna, Bihar, India.
finding: Uterine atony and uterine rupture were the most common causes of emergency peripartum hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery and repeat cesarean deliveries are likely risk factors for EPH.
